venues.name: Mother of Pearl pool / pool decks

entertainmentProgram: Entertainment is focused and venue-specific: dueling pianos at The Phoenician Tavern on weekend evenings, and ambient live music in the bars and lounges. A luxury golf and spa resort, it runs NO dedicated nightclub, disco, or produced-show theater.
dayNightFlow: Daytime centers on the pools, golf, and spa. Evening entertainment is concentrated at the Tavern (dueling pianos, Fri/Sat 8-10pm) and the lounges; there is no late-night programmed venue.
